name: Before the Sandstorm
source:
You’re a fraud posing as a therapist. You’ve been sent to care for the research team exploring ancient ruins on Cineris, but things take a dark turn when the team awakens the complex. 

Interview the crew, uncover hidden agendas, and find the truth before it’s too late.

[From [url=https://lmagitem.itch.io/before-the-sandstorm]Itch.io[/url]]
